title: [review] lichend.rs: Mutex unwrap can panic on poisoned lock
description: `tx_queue.lock().unwrap()` will panic if the mutex is poisoned (another thread panicked while holding the lock). In a daemon, this causes an unclean crash. Use `.lock().ok()` or `.lock().unwrap_or_else()` with recovery logic, or let the poison propagate explicitly.
close_reason: Fixed: Replaced all tx_queue.lock().unwrap() calls with .unwrap_or_else(|poisoned| poisoned.into_inner()) to recover gracefully from poisoned mutex instead of panicking. Also removed unused sync::mpsc import.
